name: HoloMoves: Planet Puzzle
summary:
PlanetPuzzle is a mixed reality exergame designed to encourage movement and cognitive activity in a playful and accessible environment. In a visual universe with different planets, players are invited to move around physically through space while completing simple cognitive tasks.
The game includes three levels featuring spelling tasks, math exercises, and matching challenges. It combines movement in space with mental engagement, which can help increase involvement and motivation during exercise sessions.
